title: 3-Ingredient Banana Peanut Butter Oat Cookies
hookLine: Soft, chewy breakfast-worthy cookies made from 3 whole foods: ripe bananas, rolled oats & peanut butter.

steps.title: Preheat Oven & Prep Your Pan
steps.instructionTemplate: Preheat your oven to 350°F (175°C) and line your baking pan with parchment paper, leaving a slight overhang for effortless lifting. Measure out {oc_ban} and {oc_oat} so everything is ready and at room temperature for a silky, lump-free batter.

steps.title: Scoop Rounds & Bake Until Golden
steps.instructionTemplate: Mash {oc_ban} with {oc_pb}, fold in {oc_oat}, flatten 8 cookie mounds on parchment, and bake at 350°F (175°C) for 10 mins. Let 3-Ingredient Banana Peanut Butter Oat Cookies cool for 10–15 minutes so the crumb sets cleanly before slicing into 8 portions, then garnish and serve.
steps.creatorSecret: Use room-temperature dairy and eggs for 3-Ingredient Banana Peanut Butter Oat Cookies, and pull it from the oven when the edges are set and a toothpick has moist crumbs—overbaking dries it out.

steps.title: Bake 3-Ingredient Banana Peanut Butter Oat Cookies & Check Doneness
steps.instructionTemplate: Bake for 10 minutes until the edges turn golden and set while the center remains tender. Test with a toothpick—if it comes out with a few moist crumbs rather than wet batter, it is ready.

steps.title: Cool Completely, Garnish & Serve
steps.instructionTemplate: Transfer 3-Ingredient Banana Peanut Butter Oat Cookies to a wire cooling rack and let it cool for 15–20 minutes so the interior sets cleanly without crumbling. Lift out using the parchment overhang, garnish as desired, and slice into 8 portions.

ugcQuotes.quote: Zero refined sugar and only 145 cal—tastes like total indulgence!
